title: Multilingual European Language Models: Benchmarking Approaches and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing existing multilingual benchmarks for English-centric and US-centric cultural biases, and reviewing mitigation strategies such as using human annotators to label culturally sensitive samples (e.g., GlobalMMLU) or creating benchmarks from local/regional knowledge sources (e.g., Include).

Evaluating the impact of "translationese" (unnatural linguistic artifacts resulting from source language interference in translated benchmarks) and assessing the use of human post-editing and automated translation quality metrics (like the COMET score) to measure and mitigate it.
